desc:
⚠️ PRIVATE SERVERS ARE MOVED TO INGAME MENUS AS CODE-BASED JOINING TO ACCOMMODATE CONSOLE AND NEW REGIONS ⚠️

This is a Parry-based Cultivation Murim Fighting RPG Game, with increased difficulty

Enter the Murim as an unknown martial artist. Train your body, cultivate your qi, and pursue strength beyond mortal limits. The path to mastery is unforgiving, and not every battle is yours to win.
Fight with fists or steel. Read your opponent, parry their strikes, and turn an opening into victory. Reckless attacks leave you exposed; strength alone will not save you.

Face dangerous qi beasts and rival martial artists. Learn from defeat, refine your techniques, and overcome those who once stood beyond your reach.
Temper your body. Sharpen your blade. Forge your path.

CODES ON INGAME MENU

CONTROLLER/MOBILE ✓

KEYBINDS
M1 / Left Click - Light Attack
M2 / Right Click - Heavy Attack
F - Parry
Q - Directional Dodge
Shift - Sprint
Alt - Lock Camera
T - Target Lock
N - Map
Y - Execute
Space - Jump
